name: event-chronicle
description: 从 AI 对话中提取事件，构建可视编年史，形成长期记忆
author: Tilex

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run build:browser
scripts.sync:st: npm run build:browser && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.copyFileSync('dist/browser/browser.mjs','st-extension/lib/ec-sdk.mjs');console.log('[sync:st] Copied browser.mjs -> st-extension/lib/ec-sdk.mjs')"
scripts.sync:st:push: npm run sync:st && git add st-extension/lib/ec-sdk.mjs && git commit -m "chore: sync ec-sdk.mjs from SDK browser build" && git subtree push --prefix=st-extension origin st-extension
